query:
SELECT k.v AS "key!", d.id
            FROM unnest($3::text[]) AS k(v)
            JOIN devices d ON d.tenant_id = $1 AND (
                ($2 = 'id' AND d.id::text = k.v)
                OR ($2 = 'serial_number' AND d.serial_number = k.v)
                OR ($2 = 'endpoint_id' AND d.endpoint_id = k.v))
